text: Underway in this heavyweight league clash.
CR-7000 signals immediately, claiming the magenta ball in the centre circle.
BellingRAM is clean through on goal!
Driving straight through the middle now.
GOAL! BellingRAM slots it home from point-blank range, giving Singularity United a lightning 1-0 lead!
Haalandroid loses balance on the touchline.
Haalandroid crunches into Zidroid, sending the Real Machina striker sprawling on the right flank.
BellingRAM flattens CR-7000 over on the touchline.
A miscommunication in the white ranks as Zidroid collides with teammate CR-7000 and hits the deck.
Incredible, Zidroid and CR-7000 bump into each other again! Complete disarray between the league leaders.
Zidroid retaliates with a hefty challenge, knocking BellingRAM flat in the final third.
Haalandroid charges towards the goal mouth!
Zidroid calls to clear danger.
Relentless pressure from Singularity United.
BellingRAM topples over unaided right before the line, giving Real Machina a brief reprieve.
Zidroid breaks clean through alone!
Just wide! A whisker away from leveling the score.
Singularity United pile on the pressure.
GOAL! BellingRAM doubles the lead from two metres out! Singularity United lead 2-0!
CR-7000 surges forward in response!
GOAL! Real Machina strike right back! CR-7000 fires home, cutting the deficit to 2-1!
CR-7000 coordinates coverage out wide to deal with the rebound off the wall.
Singularity United go close, shaving the upright from two metres out!
CR-7000 stumbles and falls backward in the defensive third, needing time to reboot balance.
Haalandroid transmits attacking intent, looking to pounce on the loose ball inside the penalty area.
A speculative effort flashes inches wide of the far post.
CR-7000 signals to work the ball away.
CR-7000 clatters into BellingRAM out wide.
Singularity United are camping deep in the opposition third, forcing Real Machina into desperate defensive mode.
BellingRAM crunches into CR-7000 down the touchline, leaving the white shirt flat on the turf.
Agonisingly close from close range!
Zidroid bursts straight down the middle on the break!
GOAL! Zidroid levels the match from point-blank range! It is 2-2 with under a minute left in the half!
Zidroid drives forward once again!
GOAL! Zidroid strikes twice in seconds! Real Machina take a 3-2 lead!
Zidroid immediately signals to hunt the restart in midfield, smelling blood before the break.
GOAL! A pure first-half hat-trick for Zidroid! Real Machina now lead 4-2!
Real Machina control the final seconds.
Half time. A blistering turnaround from the league leaders leaves Real Machina 4-2 up at the interval.
Haalandroid breaks clean through midfield!
Haalandroid pushes deep into the final third, bearing down on target with great intent.
Haalandroid signals an imminent strike on goal!
Inches wide of the target!
BellingRAM loses footing near the corner.
The powered ram panel snaps out in the corner, rocketing the ball back into the mix.
Haalandroid lands a heavy challenge on CR-7000 in midfield, sending the white unit tumbling.
GOAL! BellingRAM scrambles it in from point-blank range! Singularity United are right back in this at 3-4!
Zidroid carries the ball up the right touchline.
More friendly fire for Real Machina as CR-7000 trips over Zidroid and hits the deck.
CR-7000 is clean through on goal down the right flank!
CR-7000 charges right to the net!
GOAL! CR-7000 buries it from point-blank range! Real Machina restore their cushion at 5-3!
Zidroid tracks the rebound tightly.
GOAL! BellingRAM scores from the left channel! Singularity United make it 4-5 with time running out!
GOAL! Zidroid answers back with a ruthless finish! Real Machina stretch ahead 6-4!
CR-7000 is clean through into the final third!
GOAL! CR-7000 rolls it in from point-blank range! Real Machina lead 7-4!
A brief pause in the action with BellingRAM lurking near the goal. Real Machina's clinical finishing has proved decisive today.
GOAL! BellingRAM grabs a late consolation! Singularity United cut the deficit to 5-7 in the dying moments!
Full time. Real Machina win 7-5. Up next: AFC Fable versus Codex City.
